## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Wéimó jīng shū* (T2771) is another anonymous one-fascicle Vimalakīrti commentary from Dunhuang, distinct from but adjacent to [KR6i0089](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0089) (T2770). The Taishō editorial team kept these as separate texts because the manuscript witnesses, paleography, and doctrinal content differ enough to indicate independent works.

**Abstract**

T2771 is part of the Dunhuang Vimalakīrti commentary cluster. The commentary's exegetical style is direct and gloss-oriented, suggesting a teaching-text or *jiǎng yì* 講義 (lecture-notes) origin. The Tang dating bracket (600–850 CE) is established by manuscript paleography and doctrinal content; precise authorship and date are not recoverable.
